title: rubus idaeus var. marmoratus
intro: Rubus idaeus var. marmoratus, commonly known as the Marbled Raspberry, is a variant of the raspberry plant known for its unique mottled appearance. The Marbled Raspberry has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include its ability to support digestive health, reduce inflammation, and act as an antioxidant. The plant's therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it a potential remedy for various health issues. The bioactive constituents of the Marbled Raspberry include anthocyanins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
